title: Wizstar R1
lede: Wizstar R1 is a reference-to-video model that builds a short clip with sound from up to nine images or videos of your products, characters and scenes.

points: Takes up to nine reference images or videos and returns a clip of 5 to 15 seconds.
Dialogue, ambient sound and effects are generated in the same pass as the picture.
The team says it keeps a subject's identity and details stable through movement and scene changes, with less drift.
Wizstar says it is strongest on animation and 3D, and matched Seedance 2.0 on usable product-video output in internal tests.

sections.text: Creators, marketing teams and businesses that need many video variations, such as ad creatives and product videos, and are held back by generation cost.
The launch comment puts generation at $0.06 per second, and the description says eligible members get unlimited generation without spending credits.
